authorship.method: Direct model authorship from Russian in authored literal batches; mechanical merging only, no pivot target, external translator/API/model or wording-generation script.

terminology_decisions.Guests: האורחים denotes creatures, ordinary visitors generally מבקרים. Hebrew has no uppercase; source-capitalization distinction explained in124.
terminology_decisions.committee: Full הוועדה למצבי חירום consistently; source КЧС and official FEMA/МЧС evidence retained.
terminology_decisions.psychics: בעלי יכולת על־חושית broad extrasensory service, not clairvoyance-only.
terminology_decisions.spirits: רוח האורח and רוח המת are distinct attributed service terminology, not creatures.
terminology_decisions.mushrooms: מלקט הפטריות, ארץ הפטריות, תפטיר, פסטיבל הפטריות, ספר לימוד החיוכים; רמזים clues.
terminology_decisions.unknown_sex: Native role nouns קול/מענה/תפקיד and medical consultation construction retain agency without canonical sex. Their grammatical gender is not biological sex. Explicit known sex retained; source gender-evidence quotes preserved. Teen entry neutral label דמות, cat and Death grammatical forms with explicit biological uncertainty.
terminology_decisions.actions: לשחרר ending check without expulsion; action label references matched. Infinitives avoid unnecessary address sex.
terminology_decisions.brands: Hebrew אנרז׳קה, בובר צ׳רני, מרגורו; For Rest/AURACAM/CR Channel exact.
terminology_decisions.register: Neighbour informal singular, tourist polite singular, criminal slang; source sarcasm, religious register and disclosure timing retained.
